neighbours.label: the token ' Microsoft' as a brand name before a product (Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office, Microsoft SQL Server)
fire: The reports are written in Microsoft Word and shared by email.
You will need Microsoft Excel to open the spreadsheet.
The server runs Microsoft SQL Server on a single machine.
Our team switched to Microsoft Teams for meetings.
The game is only available on Microsoft Xbox consoles.
Students get Microsoft Office for free through the school.
The app works with Microsoft Outlook and other mail clients.
Install the latest Microsoft Edge update before starting.
quiet: The reports are written in Google Docs and shared by email.
You will need Apple Numbers to open the spreadsheet.
The server runs Oracle Database on a single machine.
Our team switched to Zoom for meetings.
The game is only available on Sony PlayStation consoles.
Students get Adobe Acrobat for free through the school.
The app works with Mozilla Thunderbird and other mail clients.
Install the latest Firefox update before starting.
